newsitem.title: INDIA: Strong demand for new teas at Calcutta auction.
newsitem.headline: Strong demand for new teas at Calcutta auction.

text.p: New season teas were in strong demand at this week's Calcutta Tea Auction, traders said on Friday.
In all 8,191 packages, including 1,178 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In CTC, best Assam category was sold above 85 rupees per kg, with major blenders selective.

In orthodox, new season teas were readily absorbed between 85 rupees and 100 rupees per kg with few better sorts appreciating further. There were good enquiries from the Middle East and CIS countries, traders said.
